name: vintage-story-wiki
description: A statically-generated wiki documenting Vintage Story crafting recipes, drop rates, and world-generated structures, built directly from the game's own asset data (vanilla server + installed mods) rather than hand-maintained.

paragraphs: A statically-generated wiki documenting Vintage Story crafting recipes, drop rates, world-generated structures, decorative content (paintings/tapestries/clothing), in-game books, and natural spawn locations (ore/gem deposits, wild crops, trees, entity habitats), built directly from the game's own asset data (vanilla server + installed mods) rather than hand-maintained. This is the contributor/maintainer doc; the site's own Info tab (INFO.md) is a separate, simpler document aimed at visitors; CLAUDE.md is for a future AI coding session picking up this repo.

It's natural to ask whether a small companion mod that hooks the real dedicated server's ModSystem lifecycle (AssetsFinalize/StartServerSide) and dumps its already-resolved, in-memory state would be more robust than re-implementing patch application and variant expansion in TypeScript.
